description: Free. The library’s playbooks: how parts are placed, moved, made accessible and kept fast, with the reason for every rule and a checklist. Without an id, the list (title, summary, the parts each covers); with an id, the playbook in full as markdown. get_kit and get_recipe name the playbooks that cover their parts: read those (playbooks) before wiring the parts; the ones under playbooksIfUsed only when the build uses that part or does that work.

id.description: Optional: the playbook id, e.g. placement or accessibility.

title: Read a playbook
